name: Pusher Channels Sandbox
free_limit: 200,000 messages per day; 100 concurrent connections; standard support; hosted realtime pub/sub channels
watch_out: A published message and each delivery to a subscribed client count separately toward the 200,000 daily message quota (one publish to 50 subscribers = 51 messages). Pusher says it emails users approaching plan limits and allows some headroom for unexpected spikes; do not assume an exact hard-stop or automatic paid overage on Sandbox. SLA is reserved for select enterprise customers. Official signup credit-card requirement remains unconfirmed.
